description: Our E-EDR AF road EAB lets you tackle longer, steeper climbs on your outings without penalising yourself on the flat sections.

components.description: Special rear axle
DUB PressFit bottom bracket

SRAM APEX disc brakes with 160 mm rotors at the front and back.; The APEX brakes are hydraulic. This gives you progressive, more powerful braking than with cable-actuated hydraulic brakes.; You will need to bed these brakes in. Just do a set of 20 progressive brakes at a low speed (20 km/h), then a second set at 30 km/h. You need to thoroughly wear in both brakes.; This enables better traction between the pad and the disc.
Sram Apex

This bike comes with the BC 900 bike computer. It has been specially designed for this bike and is the perfect way to interact with your bike.; This GPS computer tells you the battery level, how much range you have left and your assistance level.; You can connect the BC900 to the Decathlon Connect app for more details on your rides.
Sram Apex 1x 42T chainset; Variable crank length depending on bike size; XS 165 mm; S 170 mm; M 172.5 mm; L 175 mm; XL 175 mm
Rear derailleur and front derailleur: Sram Apex

Ride over 100 km with its 250 Wh battery and more than 160 km with the extender; 120 km - 1000 m elevation gain - Assistance levels 1&2 - 24.7 kph average speed - With extender:163 km - 1500 m elevation gain - Assistance levels 1&2 - 23.8 kph average speed - 24% battery left.; Empty extender.; 60 km - 354 m elevation gain - Assistance level 2 - 23.8 km/h average speed.; 91 km - 1296 m elevation gain - Assistance level 2; 67 km - 1118 m elevation gain - 26.2 kph average speed - Assistance levels 1&2; With extender:112 km - 2934 m elevation gain - 23.4 kph average speed - Assistance levels 1&2; 40 km - 900 m elevation gain - 20 kph average speed - Assistance level 3; With extender:65 km -1600 elevation gain - 20 km/h average speed - Assistance level 3
Attack your climbs with the motor's 40 Nm of torque at 250 W.
The fork is 100% carbon for incredibly precise steering. It also has mounting holes on the sides that can carry up to 4 kg on each blade.
The E-EDR AF's cockpit is made entirely of aluminium, with a Van Rysel stem and handlebar.; Handlebar size; XS 400 mm; S 400 mm; M 420 mm; L 420 mm; XL 440 mm
You can carry up to 10 kg on a pannier rack if you choose to install one.
19C inner rim width; 12x100 front axle
Van Rysel Sport 900 saddle
Van Rysel aluminium seat post, 27.2 mm diameter; XS: 200 mm; S: 300 mm; M/L/XL: 350 mm
Sram Apex
The stem size varies depending on the bike size:; XS 80 mm; S 90 mm; M 100 mm; L 110 mm; XL 120 mm
Van Rysel 32 mm tyre: the perfect balance of performance and robustness. We expect it to last for 6000 km in normal road cycling conditions.

The E-EDR AF is part of our endurance range. AF stands for aluminium frame. The bikes in our endurance range are designed for cyclists whose priority is the pleasure of riding.; With its aluminium frame and the Mahle kit (3.5 kg), this electric road bike is both light and comfortable.; To keep you safe, the entire range is equipped with hydraulic disc brakes as well as 32 mm tyres.
Van Rysel wheels, specially designed for e-bikes.; Tubeless-ready wheels.; Please note: always carry a 17 mm spanner with you so you can take your back wheel off if you get a puncture!
